end.summary:
• Circle parts were named: radius, chord, diameter, arc, segment and sector.
• Radius, diameter and chord relationships were practised using examples and measurements.
• Dev correctly stated that only diameters pass through the centre and that the diameter is the longest chord.
• The segment–sector mix-up was corrected later using the pizza-slice example; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised circle vocabulary and used centre-point and length comparisons to explain radius, diameter and chords. Dev correctly identified that only diameters pass through the centre and later corrected the idea that a chord could be longer than the diameter. At home, ask them to label a circle and explain why a pizza slice is a sector while the straight-cut piece is a segment.
